<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="685.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>

</text>

<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="973" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.selected_configuration: explicit static module profile; not a runtime observation

sourceFacts: h_out2<=32 selects the real low-rank einsum branch with k3 factors. h_mat is weight_norm reparameterized by BiAttention; it is not a plain final Parameter named h_mat.
FCNet includes Dropout.2 before WeightNorm Linear and ReLU; only the visual path gets the extra attention Dropout.5.
Zero visual rows are detected from original v; source mutates logits.data with -inf, then Softmax normalizes flattened V*Q jointly for each glimpse.
forward_all returns p and masked logits; logit=True alternate raw-only path is outside this selected profile.
Graph ranks only allocate space. Explicit edges supply real operands; no upstream code is imported or executed.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
